field.label: Interface name
field.help: TUN interface name, e.g. tun0. Assign it under Interfaces -> Assignments after first start.

field.label: Virtual IPv4
field.help: Virtual IPv4 address of the TUN interface. Policy-route proxy traffic here as gateway.

field.label: Virtual IPv6
field.help: Optional virtual IPv6 address of the TUN interface.

field.label: Multi-queue
field.help: Enable multi-queue support on the TUN interface.
